messages:
alice-finance: Heads up — our March invoice (INV-2026-03-11) shows a ~$42k overage on Dedicated GPU usage. Suspect promo credits got applied to the wrong line and then expired before the reserved commitment consumption was netted. Can infra confirm tag propagation for reserved pools?
ryan-ops: looking. which commitment ID?
alice-finance: commit-cc-2026-01, reserved 8xA100 eu-west. The invoice shows promo:SPRING24 applied to the hosted usage line, not the reserved commit.
jordan-sre: that sounds like the region-tag mismatch we've seen — eu-west reserved pools use tag rsv:euw but billing pipeline expects commit:cc-* tags.
mia-payments: billing-bot ledger shows promo:SPRING24 consumed on 2026-03-01 02:13 UTC against account main-prod. Entry -> ``{ "tx": "promo-apply", "code": "SPRING24", "amount": 50000, "applied_to": "acct:main-prod/hosted" }``. Expiry on 2026-03-08.
billing-bot: automated note — promo SPRING24 was auto-applied by promo-engine v2.1. Rule: apply to latest invoiceable balance. No explicit pin to commit lines.
ryan-ops: we did roll a change on 2026-02-28 that flipped tag normalization. Some reserved pools lost the commit: prefix in the billing export. I'll scope which clusters were affected.
tara-product: customer-facing risk: if reserved consumption wasn't matched to the commitment, they get charged public rates — we need to avoid that for customers on contracts.
lex-support: any customers already reached out about unexpected overage? We have one support ticket #8732 — user reports large billed amount.
alice-finance: yes, support escalated. Requested retro credit if this is a billing-side misallocation.
ryan-ops: quick check: `gcloud billing export list --filter="labels.commitment:commit-cc-2026-01 OR labels.reserve:true" --format=json | jq '.[] | {id,labels}'` shows 6/8 GPUs missing labels.commitment. Seems tagging pipeline dropped for autoscale nodes in eu-west-2.
jordan-sre: probable root cause: node autoattacher service crashed during rollout and nodes came up with generic labels. I'll open a PR with a fix and also run a backfill to update resource labels where possible.
mia-payments: for the immediate billing fix, finance can request a retroactive reallocation from cloud billing if we provide a mapping of usage lines -> commitment. We need the usage CSV and a reconciliation log. How fast can infra produce that?
ryan-ops: I can generate per-VM usage with kafka logs and the map, should have CSV in ~2 hours. Will also produce a list of nodes created between 2026-02-28 and 2026-03-06.
alice-finance: okay please cc me when done. I'll draft the credit appeal to cloud billing and the customer-facing note.
billing-bot: action required — create support case with cloud billing referencing invoice INV-2026-03-11 and attach usage CSV. Suggested subject: "Retroactive promo allocation + commitment mapping".
tara-product: also recommend a short postmortem and a flag to pin promo codes to contract commits when present. That would avoid auto-apply stealing credits from reserved capacity.
lex-support: I'll notify the impacted customer that we're investigating and will post an interim credit if confirmed. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
alice-finance: thanks team. Ryan, ping here when CSV is uploaded. I'll open the cloud appeal and loop legal if needed.
ryan-ops: uploaded to s3://redwood-billing/recon/1799456789/usage-mapping.csv — sharing to the billing case now.
mia-payments: received. Opening case: CASE-CC-5794. Keeping stakeholders tagged.
alice-finance: filing retro credit request now. ETA from cloud billing could be 5-10 business days. Will follow up. :crossed_fingers:
